name: Views
blurb: Where the city finally makes sense as a shape. Go at dusk.

places.name: Kerry Park
places.note: The postcard. Skyline, Rainier behind it, Sound to the right. Tiny park, go at dusk.
places.address: Kerry Park, 211, Queen Anne, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98119, United States

places.name: Gas Works Park
places.note: Climb the mound. Downtown across Lake Union with seaplanes landing in front of it.
places.address: Gas Works Park, 2101, Fremont, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98103, United States

places.name: Sky View Observatory
places.note: 73rd floor of Columbia Center, the tallest public view in the city. Costs money, worth it once.
places.address: Sky View Observatory, 701, 5th Avenue, Central Business District, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98104, United States

places.name: Smith Tower Observatory
places.note: 1914 open-air deck with a speakeasy attached. Lower than the Columbia Center and far more charming.
places.address: Smith Tower Observatory, 506, 2nd Avenue, West Edge, First Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98104, United States

places.name: Dr. Jose Rizal Park
places.note: Beacon Hill. The skyline framed by the freeway, and almost never crowded.
places.address: Dr. Jose Rizal Park, 1007, Yesler Terrace, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98144, United States

places.name: Hamilton Viewpoint Park
places.note: West Seattle, looking straight down the throat of Elliott Bay at downtown.
places.address: Hamilton Viewpoint Park, Seattle, King County, Washington, United States

places.name: Volunteer Park Water Tower
places.note: 106 steps up a brick tower for a free 360 of the city. Nobody tells visitors about it.
places.address: Volunteer Park Water Tower, Volunteer Park Road, Madison Valley, Capitol Hill, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98102, United States

places.name: Alki Beach Park
places.note: The skyline from across the water, with sand under you. Sunset is the move.
places.address: Alki Beach Park, West Seattle, Seattle, King County, Washington, United States
